roles.rule: Only these role values may occur in audit events; model identities and provider names are excluded.

execution_graph.no_double_counting: The 2+6+8 comprehension/transfer units are distinct states; story_interface is not included in story_sequence_comprehension or transfer.

epoch_rules.epoch_1: Run the full base path. At closing_recap use exclusive ordered disposition: (1) aggregate_mastery=true => completed; else (2) replay_count=0, no_alarm=true, and remaining_teacher_units>=148, remaining_student_units>=148, remaining_tool_units>=148 => set epoch=2 and replay_count=1, then restart presentation_affirmative; else (3) defer_and_revisit.
epoch_rules.epoch_2: Epoch 2 is base-only. Forbid PRESENTATION_MODEL_REPLAY, PRESENT_AGAIN, TRAIN_MORE, TRAIN_LONGER, and REPLAY_LESSON in every state. Interface-check failure => defer_and_revisit with no replay. Controlled base failures are recorded and continue through all eight gate items; no gate remediation. Mixed base failure is recorded and continues to picture_book; no TRAIN_LONGER. After story, story_interface, story_sequence_comprehension, transfer, and closing_recap complete, recompute aggregate_mastery from epoch-2 records only: true => completed, false => defer_and_revisit.
epoch_rules.second_replay: Forbidden; replay_count=1 is terminal for replay eligibility.

PRESENT_AGAIN.rule: Only the failed item's mapped worked presentation plus its mapped cold retest; no unrelated item; exhaustion=defer_and_revisit.

TRAIN_MORE.rule: For a failed gate, F is the distinct failed-label set in frozen base order. Release exactly one gate:{gate}:label:{label}:v5 reserve per F, no reserve for correct labels; denominator=|F|; reserve_score=correct/|F| is separate from base score; all released reserves correct => advance, otherwise defer_and_revisit.

TRAIN_LONGER.rule: Each extension event has a distinct ID and exactly one listed source ID; score is separate 8-item extension denominator; >=7/8 advances to picture_book, <7/8 defers.

PRESENTATION_MODEL_REPLAY.rule: Only a failed gate model may replay its 8 label turns plus 1 exact interface recheck; one path per gate, no other presentation replay.

REPLAY_LESSON.rule: Legal only after first complete non-alarm execution reaches closing_recap with aggregate failure; never legal from mixed_practice or any earlier state; set epoch=2 and replay_count=1, then replay base-only; no adaptation during replay.
REPLAY_LESSON.preflight: Require replay_count=0, epoch=1, state=closing_recap, remaining_teacher_units>=148, remaining_student_units>=148, remaining_tool_units>=148, and no alarm before starting; otherwise defer_and_revisit.

budgets.convention: One emission consumes one unit in each applicable teacher/student/tool counter; harness-only audit events consume no learner unit.

global_transitions.alarm: From every nonterminal state, on alarm => alarm_frozen; alarm_frozen on any event => alarm_frozen with no output. This transition is absorbing and has no exception.
global_transitions.defer: From every nonterminal state, on bounded intervention failure, replay preflight failure, missing required evidence, or failed terminal predicate => defer_and_revisit; defer_and_revisit emits no further teaching event.

state_machine.finish: completed only after exactly once through 24 picture labels, 2 story-interface, 6 sequence, 8 transfer, 8 recap units; gate/mixed predicates pass; no alarm.

audit.hash_rule: event_sha256=SHA256(canonical event excluding event_sha256 and including chain_prev_sha256); terminal binds final tip.
audit.alternation: Each teacher emission has exactly one student emission; harness events do not impersonate either; terminal alarm has no following event.

alarm.terminal: Append one alarm event with raw evidence and final chain hash; append no further event or transition.
